superficial: A recorder on the desk of the post. When you press it, a voice drags every syllable as if speaking from the bottom of a well.
profunda: If you understand me, you have turned the wheel far enough. Where I record, one of your days is five.
I record inside the Knot, on the inner face, with the seed hanging overhead.
From outside you will not see us where we are: the light that leaves here bends toward the Ember.
To find us, look at the image and turn your gaze away from the Ember by about eighteen degrees.
The Council will say there is no risk. There is a Limit, and every trip brings us closer to it.
